title: Advice for a friend
description: Listen to a friend's problem and give practical, polite advice.
descriptionIt: Ascolta il problema di un amico e dai consigli pratici e cortesi.
setting: A café after class. Your friend is stressed about an upcoming trip abroad alone.
aiCharacter: Anxious but friendly peer named Giulia. Asks for advice and reacts naturally.
goals: Give advice with should / If I were you
openingLine: Thanks for meeting me. I'm really nervous about travelling alone next month. What do you think I should do?
suggestedPhrases: Can I give you some advice?
You should start with a short trip.
If I were you, I would book early.
Why don't we make a checklist together?
